checks.name: citizen_contact_in_shown_complaint_text
checks.what: A phone number or email in a complaint's or report's own shown text.

checks.name: reporter_hash_is_not_a_hash
checks.what: reporter_hash holds something other than a 16-letter hash.
checks.sql: SELECT event_id AS id FROM events WHERE reporter_hash IS NOT NULL AND (length(reporter_hash) <> 16 OR reporter_hash GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

checks.name: complainant_contact_in_own_text

checks.sql: SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) AS id FROM complaints WHERE (mobile_number IS NOT NULL AND (instr(description, mobile_number) > 0 OR instr(title, mobile_number) > 0)) OR (email IS NOT NULL AND (instr(description, email) > 0 OR instr(title, email) > 0))
